# Mark Klein writes for Corporate Counsel about the rise of the "strategic GC"


July 7, 2025


-
-
-
-


ALM's *Corporate Counsel* has featured a piece written by[Mark Klein](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/mark-klein/) entitled "The Strategic GC: Turning Legal From Cost Center to Value Creator."


Klein writes: "The shift from legal gatekeeper to strategic partner is accelerating. And nowhere is that transformation more evident than in how GCs are approaching litigation and legal finance."


[Read the full article here.](https://www.law.com/corpcounsel/2025/07/07/the-strategic-gc-turning-legal-from-cost-center-to-value-creator/)
